_comment: Intentionally invalid REST mapping examples — for documentation and testing reference only. Each route demonstrates a specific validation error. This file is NOT a valid mapping config and will be rejected by RestMappingConfig.from_dict().

routes._error: INVALID: methods is empty — every route must declare at least one method
routes.name: empty-methods

routes._error: INVALID: unrecognized HTTP method 'FETCH' — only standard HTTP methods and '*' are accepted
routes.name: bad-method

routes._error: INVALID: path_pattern does not start with '/' — all paths must be absolute
routes.name: relative-path

routes._error: INVALID: resource_type is empty — must be a non-empty string
routes.name: empty-resource-type

routes._error: INVALID: resource_id_template references {building_id} which is not a capture in path_pattern
routes.name: unknown-capture-ref

routes._error: INVALID: action 'fly' in action_map is not a recognized action verb
routes.name: invalid-action

routes._error: INVALID: malformed capture token '{device_id' — missing closing brace
routes.name: malformed-capture

routes._error: INVALID: duplicate capture name '{device_id}' in path_pattern
routes.name: duplicate-capture
